meta.title: AI Capex Unwind — April 2026
meta.claim: Hyperscaler AI capex (~$320B/yr across MSFT/META/GOOGL/AMZN, ~30% of S&P capex growth) hits three convergent constraints: (1) physical power capacity, (2) Blackwell+ saturation creating GPU price softness, (3) CFO ROI fatigue. Capex guide-down → semis crater → utilities re-rate (less power demand than priced) → datacenter REITs roll (peak leases) → broad multiple compression. Trade the transmission, not the headline.

nodes.label: Hyperscaler Capex Guide
nodes.context: Top 4 hyperscalers (MSFT, META, GOOGL, AMZN) collectively guided ~$320B FY26 capex on Q4-2025 calls — up from ~$220B FY25. Q1 prints land late-Apr/early-May. Any of the four guiding flat/down for FY26 is the trigger event. META Q4-2022 -22% reset (stock $328→$90) is the canonical analog. Calibration TBD on which name moves first.

nodes.label: GPU Secondary Price
nodes.context: H100 secondary rental rate has slipped from $4.50/hr peak (mid-2024) to ~$2.10/hr as Blackwell ships in volume. Below $1.50 = clear glut signal — historically marks the inflection where hyperscalers slow new orders rather than write down inventory. Calibration TBD: no clean public series; tracked manually via SF Compute / GPU broker quotes.

nodes.label: Datacenter Power Limit
nodes.context: Northern Virginia (PJM/Loudoun) interconnect queue >5 years for new utility-scale loads. ERCOT large-load study capped 2026 datacenter additions ~12 GW vs 22 GW requested. Power, not chips, is the binding constraint on next-gen builds. When Microsoft signs a nuclear PPA (Three Mile Island restart, $0.115/kWh, ~3x merchant) the real cost shows up.

nodes.label: NVDA Hyperscaler Concentration
nodes.context: Top 4 customers = ~42% of NVDA datacenter revenue per FY25 10-K disclosures. Datacenter is ~88% of total revenue. So ~37% of NVDA total revenue is concentrated in 4 capex budgets. Any guide-down rolls through consensus EPS within one quarter — historical sell-side revision lag is 2-4 weeks post-print.

nodes.label: TSM CoWoS Utilization
nodes.context: TSMC CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity is the single physical bottleneck for Blackwell/MI300 supply. Utilization ran ~98% through 2025. Drops below 90% historically lead chip pricing by 1-2 quarters. TSM monthly revenue print is the tell. Calibration TBD: utilization reported in-line with quarterly results, monthly revenue is the high-frequency proxy.

nodes.label: Datacenter REIT Lease Pace
nodes.context: DLR + EQIX signed record leasing in 2024-25 at peak rents ($180-220/kW vs $130 long-term avg). Lease backlog ~24 months. Once hyperscalers slow signings, mark-to-market on new business resets fast — REITs have $0 negotiating power once the bid disappears. EQIX/DLR forward AFFO consensus assumes pricing power persists.

nodes.label: Semis ETF Breakdown
nodes.context: SMH 200dma is the line. 2018 trade-war analog: SMH lost 200dma in October, dropped 24% in 11 weeks. Confluence node — fires only after capex guide AND TSM utilization both confirm. The 'high-conviction short' window opens here, not before.

nodes.label: Utilities Bid Recede
nodes.context: XLU has rallied ~28% in 12 months on AI power-demand narrative. CEG, VST, NRG carry 2x sector multiples on PPA pipeline assumptions. Capex guide-down breaks the demand-curve assumption — utilities re-rate but slower than semis. Long XLU hedge thesis: even if AI capex slows, baseload power demand stays sticky and rates fall (TLT-correlated).

nodes.label: VIX / Concentration Risk
nodes.context: S&P top-7 = 33% of index weight. AI-themed names (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) = ~22%. Capex unwind concentrates losses — VIX historically prints 30+ on tech-led drawdowns even when broad index is down only 8-10%. 2018 Q4 template: VIX 12→36 in 6 weeks on chip-led rotation.

nodes.label: IG/HY Credit Stress
nodes.context: Hyperscaler debt issuance spiked in 2024-25 to fund capex (META $30B, MSFT $40B). If capex ROI questioned, IG OAS widens 30-50bps fast. HY follows with 100-200bps amplification. LQD/HYG ratio is the cleanest read.

nodes.label: S&P Multiple Compression
nodes.context: Triple-confluence node: semis-breakdown + vix-spike + credit-spreads. AI capex was ~30% of S&P capex growth in 2024-25. Strip it out and forward EPS revisions cut ~$15 from $285 consensus. At 19x that's a 5% multiple drag on top of EPS cut. Path: SPX 5500 → 4900-5000 fast.

nodes.label: Fed Cut Reaction
nodes.context: Capex-led drawdown is NOT classic recession — payrolls hold up initially because hyperscalers don't fire datacenter staff fast. Fed historically lags tech-led drawdowns by 2-3 quarters (2000, 2018Q4). Gate: Fed funds futures pricing 3+ cuts in 6mo = confirmed pivot. TLT trade requires this to fire.
nodes.condition: fed funds futures price 3+ cuts in 6mo

nodes.label: Long Bond Rally
nodes.context: TLT only works after fed-reaction gate fires. Pre-pivot the long end can keep selling on issuance fears. Don't front-run the duration trade — wait for fed-funds-futures confirmation. Earliest plausible window: late Q3 2026 if capex guide-down lands April/May.

nodes.label: Capex Re-Acceleration
nodes.context: Kill-switch for the short book. If a hyperscaler prints clean ROI on AI workloads (e.g., MSFT Copilot ARR > $20B run-rate AND attach rate > 30%) the narrative resets and capex re-accelerates. Or: Inference cost crashes 10x via custom silicon and unlocks new demand. Cut shorts on confirmation, not on rumor.
nodes.additionalCondition: Copilot ARR > $20B + attach > 30% OR custom-silicon inference 10x cheaper
nodes.action: Cut SMH/XLK short 1/2, close NVDA puts, hold XLU long, trim TLT 1/3 if held

edges.mechanism: Hyperscaler Q1 capex print ≥5% below guide → NVDA datacenter rev growth re-rates from 60% YoY to 30% YoY → consensus EPS cut 12-18% within 4 weeks → multiple compresses 15-25% on 24-month earnings risk premium
Capex slow → new lease signings pause → DLR/EQIX mark-to-market on incremental business resets to long-term avg ($130/kW vs current $180-220) → forward AFFO cuts 8-12%
Secondary GPU rental < $1.50/hr signals oversupply → hyperscalers delay/cancel orders → NVDA ASP and units both pressure
GPU glut → CoWoS bookings cut → TSM monthly revenue prints below seasonal pattern
Hyperscalers can't deploy capex they've allocated if there's no power on the grid → CFO rationalizes guide-down as 'pacing to capacity' rather than admitting demand softness
If AI demand is structurally power-capped, utilities lose the upside-case narrative — XLU re-rates from 19x to 16x as multi-decade growth scenarios fade
NVDA is 22% of SMH by weight + correlated drawdown across AVGO/AMD → SMH loses 200dma → CTA/momentum unwinds amplify 30-40%
TSM is leading indicator on chip demand globally — when TSM breaks, sector follows
REIT FFO cuts → debt service coverage tightens → DLR/EQIX bond spreads widen → contagion to broader IG REIT complex
Semis = 12% of S&P weight when including ancillary names → drawdown forces vol-target funds to de-gross → VIX bid
VIX > 25 historically correlates with HY spread widening of 50-100bps within 2 weeks
Top-7 = 33% of S&P weight → tech-led drawdown drags index 6-10% even with no broader recession
VIX > 30 forces multi-asset funds to cut equity allocation → mechanical selling pressure on index
ERP rises with credit spreads → equity multiple compresses ~1x for every 50bps of HY widening
S&P -10% from highs typically gets verbal Fed support; -15% gets cut probability priced in
Lower multiples + cheaper hardware (post-glut) eventually restore ROI math → capex re-accelerates from a lower base

utilities-rerate.role: long hedge — utilities catch bid as power-demand fears recede + rates fall

tlt-rally.role: long duration — Fed cut expectations rise on capex-led slowdown

datacenter-reit-leases.role: datacenter REIT short — peak lease pricing rolls

nvda-revenue-concentration.role: single-name short via 90-120 DTE puts — surgical
nvda-revenue-concentration.note: Puts only, no naked. 2% premium cap.

instruments.note: Add only on confirmation, not anticipation.
Short HYG via puts if HY OAS breaks 425.

scenarios.name: Soft-landing capex moderation
scenarios.notes: Most likely. Hyperscalers guide FY26 capex flat-to-up-5% (vs +25% expected). Semis pull back 8-12% but no breakdown. Utilities flat. The hedge book takes small wins, the short book breaks even.

scenarios.name: Single hyperscaler guide-down (META 2022 analog)
scenarios.notes: META Q4-2022 redux. One name (most likely META or AMZN given retail-cycle exposure) cuts FY26 capex 15-20%. Single-name -25% in week one. SMH -15%. Cross-sector contagion. NVDA puts pay 4-6x.

scenarios.name: Broad capex unwind (telecom 2001 analog)
scenarios.notes: Multiple hyperscalers cut. Power constraint + GPU glut + ROI doubt all hit simultaneously. SMH -35%. SPX -18%. Credit spreads blow out. VIX > 35. Fed pivots in Q3. TLT rallies hard. The full short book pays.

TLT.action: hold long, add on cut confirmation

scenarios.name: AI productivity proof saves the day
scenarios.notes: MSFT prints clean Copilot ARR + attach rate. ROI thesis vindicated. Capex stays elevated. Custom silicon (Trillium, MI400) drops inference cost 5-10x and unlocks new demand. Hedge book takes losses. Cut and rotate.

NVDA.action: puts expire, accept loss within premium cap

signposts.text: Any of MSFT/META/GOOGL/AMZN guides FY26 capex < consensus
TSM monthly revenue prints below seasonal
DLR/EQIX leasing pace softens on call
Sell-side EPS cuts begin (top 5 chip names)

policyResponse.label: Phase 4: Policy Response — Fed Pivot

signposts.text: Fed funds futures price 3+ cuts in 6mo

policyResponse.estimatedTiming: Q4 2026 - Q1 2027 (Fed historically lags tech-led 2-3 quarters)

signposts.text: OR: New capex base 30%+ below 2025 peak sustained 2 quarters

rules: Don't front-run the print. Build initial short positions only AFTER first hyperscaler guide-down confirms. Pre-print sizing: max 1/3 of target. Q1 print window Apr 24 - May 2.
Confluence rule: SMH short fires only when capex-guide AND tsm-utilization both confirm. Single-signal entries get cut by 1/2.
Power constraint asymmetry: XLU long is the cleanest hedge — wins in capex-up (rates lower) AND capex-down (defensive bid). Never short XLU even in re-accel scenario.
VXX decay discipline: Roll cost ~7%/mo. Tactical only. Trim 1/2 on VIX > 28, full close on VIX > 35.
NVDA puts only. Single-name shares short on the most-shorted-by-CTAs name = squeeze risk. 90-120 DTE puts, 2% premium cap, no naked calls/puts.
Don't fight the Fed. TLT trade gates on fed-reaction node. Pre-pivot the long end can keep selling on issuance fears — DO NOT add TLT until fed funds futures price 3+ cuts.
Kill switch: If capex-reaccel fires (MSFT Copilot ARR > $20B + attach > 30%), cut SMH/XLK 1/2, close NVDA puts, hold XLU.
Single-name risk cap: No single ticker > 12% of book. NVDA puts capped at $600/mo premium.
Review cadence: Daily during Q1 print window (Apr 24 - May 2). Otherwise Mon/Wed/Fri close.
Scenario discipline: Trade probability-weighted. Soft-landing (40%) means initial sizing should expect modest moves, not blow-out scenarios.

analogs.name: META Q4-2022 Capex Reset
lessons: Single-name capex guide-down can cause -25% in a week + drag sector 8-15%.
Sell-side EPS revisions lag print by 2-4 weeks — fade the first bounce.
Bottom came after 3 consecutive quarters of capex discipline + buyback announcement.
Recovery was slow until clear ROI proof emerged (Reels monetization, ad efficiency).
analogs.notes: The cleanest single-name analog. META alone rerated mega-cap growth multiples for 18 months.

analogs.name: Telecom Capex Unwind 2000-2002
lessons: When the spending narrative breaks, equipment makers de-rate violently and stay derated for years.
Credit followed equity by 12-18 months as bond covenants tripped on revenue cuts.
Survivors emerged 60-70% off peak even after operational recovery.
Multiple compression dwarfed earnings cuts — the rerating was the trade.
analogs.notes: The 'broad unwind' scenario template. Probability-weighted lower but catastrophic if it plays.

analogs.name: 2018 Q4 Tech-Led Drawdown
lessons: Chip-led drawdowns spike VIX faster than other rotations (12 → 36 in 6 weeks).
Fed pivot (Powell 'patient' Jan 2019) marked the bottom within days.
Recovery was V-shaped because no underlying recession — different from capex unwind which is structural.
Cross-sector contagion: utilities and bonds rallied even as tech bled.
analogs.notes: Useful for the 'amplification → policy response' transition timing.
